description: Place state/aggregates at the lowest component that logically owns them. Higher-level objects reference or collect (never own). Navigate through ownership chain (Parent → Child → Sub-child) instead of adding wrapper methods.

do.description: Place state at lowest level, navigate directly
content: Place state at smallest owning component
Navigate: Scope → File → Block → Violation (not Scope.GetViolations())
Example: Block reports violations (lowest level), File contains blocks, Scope encompasses files

dont.description: Don't place state at wrong levels or hide navigation
content: Don't place state higher when lower level should own it
Don't create wrapper methods that just delegate
Ask: 'What is the smallest unit that should have this state?'
